Internet Archive Wayback Machine — where each PDF was read from

note: Headline facts from the Executive Summary of each COA Annual Audit Report (AAR) on a BARMM entity. coa.gov.ph answers every automated request with a Cloudflare 403, so every PDF here was read from the Internet Archive copy of its own coa.gov.ph URL: `pdf` is the COA URL, `archived` the copy actually opened. That limits coverage to what the Archive saved: 55 municipalities and Marawi City for FY 2020 (old COA site) and Madalum for FY 2021. No regional/ministry, province or Cotabato City report could be read for any year — see `gaps`. Sulu towns are FY 2020, when Sulu was part of BARMM. Fields: opinion is the auditor's word (unmodified covers "unqualified"; "modified" where the report names no type). disallowances and suspensions are year-end outstanding Notices of Disallowance / Suspension balances; 0 only where the report says none or prints 0.00/"-", null where it does not say (several reports say only that none were issued during the year). unliquidatedCashAdvances is null almost everywhere because Executive Summaries rarely state the balance. observations counts the numbered deficiencies in the summary (favourable observations left out); recommendations counts each lettered or separate recommendation under them, which is a judgment call where they nest. priorRecommendations is as printed for prior years' recommendations (erratum pages win); a part the report does not state is null even when the others imply it. findings are plain-English restatements of the summary's most significant observations; page is the PDF page (Executive Summaries number pages in roman numerals). Every peso figure and quoted sentence was checked against the PDF text by the build script. The full AAR (Part II) often holds more observations than the summary. Left out on purpose: water districts and Marawi Resort Hotel (national GOCCs that COA files under its BARMM office) and Isabela City (Basilan, but Region IX).
